statement.name: GetInvitation
statement.sql:
SELECT inv.InvitationId , inv.UserId , inv.Comments , inv.Deadline , inv.ResourceId , inv.creatorid , inv.StatusCode , inv.ClientTaskId , res.ResourceValue , res.ResourceTypeCode , pp.PersonId , ca.ContactAddress as email , pp.FirstName , pp.LastName , pp.FirstName as FName , pp.LastName as LName , pp.MiddleName , ca2.ContactAddress as iemail , pp2.PersonId as IPersonId , pp2.FirstName as IFirstName , pp2.LastName as ILastName , pp2.MiddleName as IMiddleName , cr.ContributionResponseId as ContributionResponseId , cr.comments as responsecomments , cr.CreatedDate as responsecreateddate , invd.ActivityCode , invd.ProgramName , invd.EntityTrackingNumber , invd.EntityType , inv.lastupdatedate , invD.EntityDetails , (SELECT count(*) from PFM_CONT_Attachments ca WHERE ca.InvitationId=inv.invitationid) attchcount FROM PFM_CONT_Invitation inv INNER JOIN PFM_CONT_resources res ON inv.ResourceId = res.ResourceID INNER JOIN PFM_CONT_InvitationDetails invD ON inv.InvitationId = invD.InvitationDetailsID INNER JOIN dbo.People pp ON inv.UserId = pp.UserId INNER JOIN dbo.People pp2 ON inv.CreatorId = pp2.UserId INNER JOIN dbo.ContactAddresses ca ON ca.EntityId = pp.PersonId AND ca.ContactAddressTypeCode =1 INNER JOIN dbo.ContactAddresses ca2 ON ca2.EntityId = pp2.PersonId AND ca2.ContactAddressTypeCode =1 LEFT OUTER JOIN PFM_CONT_ContributionResponse cr ON inv.InvitationId = cr.InvitationId WHERE 1=1
AND inv.InvitationId = ''
AND res.ResourceValue = ''
AND res.ResourceTypeCode = ''
order BY inv.deadline ASC;

statement.name: DeleteInvitationItem
statement.sql:
DECLARE @InvitationId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER SET @InvitationId = ''
DECLARE @ResourceId AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER SET @ResourceId = (SELECT TOP 1 r.ResourceId FROM dbo.PFM_CONT_Invitation i JOIN dbo.PFM_CONT_Resources r ON i.ResourceId = r.ResourceID WHERE InvitationId = @InvitationId)
-- Delete all responses to invitation DELETE FROM PFM_CONT_ContributionResponse WHERE ContributionResponseId IN ( SELECT cr.ContributionResponseId FROM PFM_CONT_Invitation i JOIN PFM_CONT_Resources r ON i.ResourceId = r.ResourceID JOIN PFM_CONT_ContributionResponse cr ON cr.ResourceId = r.ResourceID and cr.InvitationId = i.InvitationId WHERE i.InvitationId = @InvitationId )
-- Delete all attachments related to invitation DELETE FROM PFM_CONT_Attachments WHERE InvitationId = @InvitationId
DELETE FROM PFM_CONT_Invitation WHERE InvitationId = @InvitationId
DELETE FROM PFM_CONT_InvitationDetails WHERE InvitationDetailsID = @InvitationId
-- If no other invitations exist, delete the resource entry. IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.PFM_CONT_Invitation WHERE ResourceId = @ResourceId) = 0) BEGIN DELETE FROM PFM_CONT_Resources WHERE ResourceID = @ResourceId END
